description: Upscale and enhance one of YOUR videos (or a public https clip) with Topaz. Full control: scale 1 to 4 (1.5x works), optional target_fps 16 to 60 where the selected model supports it, and the Topaz model (Proteus default; Artemis, Nyx, Gaia and Starlight families available). Batch up to 10 clips per call via videos: [...]. Use list_upscalers first for model availability; unreleased models cannot start through MCP or API. Each entry accepts a Switch job id from list_my_videos, its download_url or view_url, or a public https URL. Use quote_only for exact Switch token prices. Confirm quoted tokens and fingerprint using confirmed_quotes. Keep request_id across retries. Renders async; poll get_video_status per task_id.

confirmed_quotes.description: Exact quote receipts in the same order as videos.

h264_output.description: Use H.264 for broad playback compatibility. Defaults false, preserving the existing H.265 option.

model.description: Upscaler model. Default Proteus. Use list_upscalers for current availability and model specific controls. Fast 3 uses the direct Topaz API; Precise 2.5 remains available.

quote_only.description: Return exact token quotes without starting processing or deducting tokens. Requires a saved Switch clip.

request_id.description: Stable identifier for one intended batch. Reuse across retries and reloads; use a new identifier only for a deliberate new run.

scale.description: Upscale factor, 1 to 4. 1.5 is allowed. Default 2.

target_fps.description: Optional target frame rate 16 to 60 (enables frame interpolation; 60 doubles the token cost).

video.description: One clip: a Switch job id, its download_url/view_url, or a public https video URL.

videos.description: Batch of up to 10 clips (same accepted forms as video).

name: upscale_video
title: Upscale Video
